_comment: Single source of truth for facts this site states about the Incognito Browser app. Every claim is sourced and dated; anything not here must not be claimed on a page, in JSON-LD, or in a comparison row. Owner decisions 2026-09-10: Pro subscription is live, the VPN is not. Re-check the Play-sourced figures before changing checkedOn.
name: Incognito Browser

features.text: Runs in private mode all the time and wipes history, cookies and sessions when you exit the app
Keeps no browsing history or cache on the device (downloaded files are kept)
Built-in ad blocker, with a High Security Blocking option added in the May 2026 release
features.source: Google Play listing and release notes

features.text: Choice of search engine, including Google, DuckDuckGo and Bing
Agent Cloaking: masks the browser and device the site sees and can load desktop versions of sites
Settings to turn images, JavaScript and cookies on or off

pricing.pro: Incognito Pro is an optional subscription sold in the Android app through Google Play

dataSafety.summary: Google Play's Data safety section says no data is shared with third parties; the app may collect app info and performance data (crash logs and diagnostics) for analytics; data is encrypted in transit.

isNot: It does not include a VPN.
There is no iOS, desktop or web version of the browser; it is an Android app.
It is not Chrome's Incognito mode, which is a private-window feature of Google Chrome.
It is not Incogni (a data-removal service), Incogniton (an anti-detect browser) or Incognito Software Systems.
neverClaim: works on all platforms / iOS / desktop

thirdPartyMentions.text: Listed in Android Authority's "9 best privacy web browsers for Android"
thirdPartyMentions.note: Ranked 8th of 9; do not describe it as a vote or a 'best' award.
